route: official LeRobotDataset v3 and ACTPolicy in separate Miniforge environment

physical_proposal.architecture: LeRobot ACT default architecture; not the reduced smoke model
physical_proposal.steps: choose from held-out learning curve; no fixed success guarantee
physical_proposal.pretrained_backbone: official ResNet18 weights, download/cache must be planned separately
physical_proposal.normalization: mean_std from training sessions only; save with checkpoint
physical_proposal.run_concurrency: VLM planning while stationary, then ACT; avoid overlapping CPU-heavy inference on the control path

demonstrations.split: whole sessions, predetermined train/validation/test assignment; never random adjacent frames
demonstrations.expansion: increase only after dataset quality checks and held-out measurements

compute.lab_gpu_reservation: pending user arranging borrowed/lab GPU; no reservation made
